usedFor: MailChimp holds your email audience, and Givebutter receives each new subscriber as a donor record through “Create a Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new subscriber is added to an audience” in MailChimp, then “Create a Contact” in Givebutter
bestTemplate.why: Each new subscriber becomes a Givebutter contact, so fundraising starts from the same list.

watchOut: This trigger fires for any subscriber added to an audience, so check the audience before every subscriber becomes a contact.
